classification.NONEMPTY_REMOVAL: At least one eligible event has previous_context_chars_removed > 0.
classification.MISSING: Any eligible sealed block lacks a decision field or completion binding; missing events cannot be treated as NOOP.

repair_branches.BRANCH_A_NOOP: All eligible headline blocks are NOOP; remove the strip from Core, preserve historical helper, and retain old headline usability.
repair_branches.BRANCH_B_RECONSTRUCTABLE: NONEMPTY_REMOVAL exists but Native-equivalent previous window is proven; remove strip, require exact request before replay, and minimally requalify Core.
repair_branches.BRANCH_C_NOT_RECONSTRUCTABLE: NONEMPTY_REMOVAL exists and equivalence is NOT_EQUIVALENT or UNKNOWN; remove strip, narrow Core certified callsites, and fresh-fallback unprovable calls.
repair_branches.BRANCH_MISSING_OLD_EFFECT: Old dynamic fields are missing; do not reuse old timing-only headline and select B/C from provider-free binding evidence.
